name: wide-columns-suggestions-two
note: Issue #653 (pattern wide-columns R1/R2/R8, Windows): wide at standard text sizes, suggestion cards pair row-major (first card | second card). Each pair is one list item named by both titles; each card keeps its Level 2 heading, named group and Automation ID, read left then right. Down/Up move within a column, Left/Right move across, and Tab still steps card by card. Resizing to medium and back reflows the same loaded content in place (one column, then two again).

name: wide-columns-shop-grid-fill
note: Issue #653: in a window wider than the web's 1080 epx cap the Item Shop grid keeps filling the width, adding columns of at least 200 epx. assertsize sets a minimum: tiles are at least 220 epx wherever the grid is wider than 1040 epx (five 225 epx tiles in CI's 1440 epx wide window, six 229 epx tiles at 1700x1000 with --mode scale-100), where the old 1040 epx cap kept five 200 epx tiles. Hosts whose wide window is clamped below 1100 epx (e.g. 300% scale) show four tiles of about 243 epx, the same as before.
